subject: Ledger cutover: annual prepay ramp, withdrawal windows and VAT entity mapping
messages:
From: Alana Santos <alana.santos@brightbridge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Annual prepay + PO attached — VAT entity question

Hi Irene / Kimberly,

Thanks for the earlier onboarding call. We're moving forward with the annual prepay for 2027 and I've attached the PO (BrightBridge_PO_1234.pdf). A couple of asks before we sign: 

- Can you confirm the first invoice activation window and when the ledger cutover will appear in our accounting system? We need dates to align against our fiscal close.
- We have two legal entities at BrightBridge (US LLC and BrightBridge EU Ltd). Which entity should we expect the VAT invoices to be issued to? We need the invoice to map to the EU entity for reclaim.
- Please include a withdrawal cadence (monthly draws vs milestone-based) and how refundable credit balancing will appear on the ledger.

Attaching PO and our internal remit details. Happy to hop on a quick 20-min call if needed.

Best,
Alana Santos
Procurement Manager — BrightBridge Capital
Attachments: BrightBridge_PO_1234.pdf, remit_details.txt

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Alana Santos <alana.santos@brightbridge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay + PO attached — VAT entity question

Thanks Alana — appreciate the PO. Replying with a proposed plan and a couple of clarifying items.

Proposed timeline (ledger cutover + first invoice):
- Invoice activation (hosted billing): 2027-06-01 (invoice posted to ledger same day).
- First drawdown window (monthly default): 2027-06-15 — payment due 30 days after invoice date per our standard Net30.
- Escrow/retainer release (if used): milestone-based release dates to be confirmed; we can convert to monthly draws if you prefer.

VAT / entity mapping:
- Redwood will issue VAT invoices to the legal entity you designate. For reclaim purposes we recommend BrightBridge EU Ltd (please confirm exact legal name and VAT ID).
- If you want the US LLC to be billed and the EU entity to reclaim, we can support a cross-entity intercompany memo but this will delay reclaimability; recommend billing directly to the EU entity.

Operational asks from our side: 
1) Please confirm which BrightBridge entity the PO maps to and provide VAT ID.
2) Provide the bank remit for the EU entity (or confirm if payments will route through your US bank).
3) If you want monthly draws instead of milestone-based, confirm the monthly spend cadence (e.g., 1/12 of committed amount or front-weighted schedule).

I've copied Kimberly (billing ops) and Vivek (finance) to align on ledger tagging and on our side's VAT routing. I can put together a final invoice cadence document and a one-page mapping spreadsheet (VAT_Entity_Mapping_2027.xlsx) — will attach once internal sign-off is complete.

If any of this needs to accelerate, we can do a 20-min sync this afternoon.

Thanks,
Irene
Director, Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ledger cutover: annual prepay ramp, withdrawal windows and VAT entity mapping

Irene / Kimberly —

Quick note from finance: we prefer monthly drawdowns (smoother forecasting). Can Redwood post invoices on the first business day of each month and allow a 14-day payment window (we may request Net14 for this customer given our treasury cadence). If Net14 is a problem, please flag.

Also, two operational items: 
- Will the prepay be held in escrow or show as a deferred revenue balance on your ledger? We need the accounting treatment to reconcile against our internal schedules.
- If you can produce VAT invoices addressed to BrightBridge EU Ltd with VAT ID EU123456789 we can proceed.

If you want to change the invoice posting day to help us close month-end, propose invoice posting on the 1st and drawdown on the 5th.

Tom Ellis
CFO — BrightBridge Capital

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alana Santos <alana.santos@brightbridge.com>, Tom Ellis <cfo@brightbridge.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: invoice cadence + ledger treatment + VAT mapping (action items)

Hi Alana / Tom —

Thanks for the inputs. Quick summary and next steps so everyone has a clear operational playbook.

1) Invoice cadence and payment terms
- Redwood will post invoices on the 1st business day of each month.
- Drawdown execution: funds will be captured on the 5th of each month (monthly auto-withdraw).
- Payment terms agreed: Net14 for BrightBridge (as requested).

2) Ledger & accounting treatment
- Prepay will be recorded as deferred revenue on Redwood's ledger. Monthly consumption will be recognized as revenue against the draws.
- Escrow: we will not place funds in escrow for this arrangement unless BrightBridge requests it in writing. Escrow costs would be billed separately.

3) VAT / entity mapping
- We will invoice BrightBridge EU Ltd (legal name as provided) and issue VAT invoices showing VAT ID EU123456789. Please confirm full legal name spelling to match your reclaim submission.
- Attaching VAT_Entity_Mapping_2027.xlsx with column mapping for invoice fields and reclaim references.

4) Remit & bank details
- Please remit to: Payments Ops <ops@payments.example.com> (we will provide a per-entity bank account file).
- Kimberly (cc) will send the final remit file and the MCP_Signed_Invoice_Template.pdf to BrightBridge accounting by EOD tomorrow.

Action items: 
- Alana: confirm BrightBridge EU Ltd exact legal name and remit bank for EU entity (due 2027-05-14).
- Tom: confirm Net14 approval from treasury (if any change, notify by 2027-05-14).
- Redwood (Kimberly / Irene / Vivek): upload final VAT mapping and DocuSign invoice terms (DocuSign link included).

Attachments: VAT_Entity_Mapping_2027.xlsx, MCP_Signed_Invoice_Template.pdf

Thanks — happy to run a short wrap-up call if there are follow-ups.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Billing & Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: VAT_Entity_Mapping_2027.xlsx; MCP_Signed_Invoice_Template.pdf
